title: Monkey wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="13" ry="12" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <!-- left arm -->
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="74" rx="7" ry="12" fill="#8B5A2B" transform="rotate(20 26 74)"/>
  <!-- right arm -->
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="74" rx="7" ry="12" fill="#8B5A2B" transform="rotate(-20 74 74)"/>
  <!-- left leg -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="94" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="94" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="22" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <!-- left ear -->
  <circle cx="29" cy="44" r="9" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <circle cx="29" cy="44" r="5" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <!-- right ear -->
  <circle cx="71" cy="44" r="9" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <circle cx="71" cy="44" r="5" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="15" ry="13" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="47" r="3" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="47" r="3" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="46" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="46" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#5C3317"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M44 59 Q50 65 56 59" stroke="#5C3317" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points="50,12 36,38 64,38" fill="#FF4D6D"/>
  <polygon points="50,12 36,38 50,38" fill="#FF7A8A"/>
  <!-- hat brim -->
  <rect x="34" y="36" width="32" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  <!-- hat stripes -->
  <polygon points="46,20 54,20 52,28 44,28" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  <polygon points="44,30 48,30 46,36 42,36" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  <!-- hat pom -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="11" r="4" fill="#FFD93D"/>
</svg>
